candidates.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM invoices WHERE InvoiceDate>=:start AND InvoiceDate<:end GROUP BY month ORDER BY ROUND(revenue, 2) DESC, month LIMIT 1

intent.metric: 2010年销售金额、上一年金额及同比增长率是多少？增长率用小数，基期为0时返回NULL。

candidates.sql: WITH amounts AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN InvoiceDate>=:start AND InvoiceDate<:end THEN Total ELSE 0 END) AS current_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN InvoiceDate>=:previous_start AND InvoiceDate<:start THEN Total ELSE 0 END) AS previous_amount FROM invoices) SELECT current_amount, previous_amount, (current_amount-previous_amount)*1.0/NULLIF(previous_amount,0) AS growth_rate FROM amounts
